<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="375" height="812" viewBox="0 0 375 812">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="375" height="812" fill="#F0F0F1"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="375" height="28" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="18" y="19" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="302" y1="17" x2="306" y2="17" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="309" y1="14" x2="313" y2="14" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="316" y1="11" x2="320" y2="11" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="331" cy="15" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="328" y1="18" x2="334" y2="12" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="344" y="9" width="22" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="347" y="12" width="15" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="366" y="13" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="28" width="375" height="101" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <g>
    <circle cx="31" cy="73" r="18" fill="#F0F0F1"/>
    <polyline points="35,66 28,73 35,80" fill="none" stroke="#007AFF" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <line x1="29" y1="73" x2="40" y2="73" stroke="#007AFF" stroke-width="2.2"/>
  </g>
  <text x="62" y="68" font-family="Poppins" font-size="22" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Price alerts</text>
  <text x="62" y="91" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">Track fare changes for your saved flights</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="317" y="55" width="38" height="38" rx="19" fill="#3865E0"/>
    <rect x="333" y="63" width="2" height="15" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="334" cy="59" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="345" cy="63" r="4" fill="#FF9500"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Section heading -->
  <text x="16" y="155" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Your alerts</text>
  <text x="304" y="155" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#007AFF">Manage</text>

  <!-- Alert card 1 shadow and body -->
  <g>
    <rect x="17" y="169" width="341" height="202" rx="5" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="16" y="167" width="341" height="202" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <g>
      <rect x="31" y="183" width="75" height="24" rx="12" fill="#E8EEFF"/>
      <circle cx="44" cy="195" r="4" fill="#3865E0"/>
      <text x="54" y="200" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#3865E0">ACTIVE</text>
    </g>
    <text x="31" y="232" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">St. Petersburg → Tallinn</text>
    <text x="31" y="254" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">LED · TLL  •  Round trip</text>
    <line x1="31" y1="268" x2="342" y2="268" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="31" y="291" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">Lowest fare found</text>
    <text x="31" y="316" font-family="Poppins" font-size="22" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">$128</text>
    <text x="91" y="315" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">per traveler</text>
    <text x="31" y="343" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">Updated today, 08:32</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="280" y="287" width="48" height="26" rx="13" fill="#3865E0"/>
      <circle cx="315" cy="300" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    </g>
    <text x="280" y="337" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#007AFF">View fares</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="280" y="344" width="61" height="20" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CCCCCC" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="292" y="358" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#777777">Delete</text>
      <line x1="329" y1="351" x2="335" y2="357" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="1.3"/>
      <line x1="335" y1="351" x2="329" y2="357" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Alert card 2 shadow and body -->
  <g>
    <rect x="17" y="388" width="341" height="202" rx="5" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="16" y="386" width="341" height="202" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <g>
      <rect x="31" y="402" width="75" height="24" rx="12" fill="#E8EEFF"/>
      <circle cx="44" cy="414" r="4" fill="#3865E0"/>
      <text x="54" y="419" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#3865E0">ACTIVE</text>
    </g>
    <text x="31" y="451" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">New York → London</text>
    <text x="31" y="473" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">JFK · LHR  •  Round trip</text>
    <line x1="31" y1="487" x2="342" y2="487" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="31" y="510" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">Lowest fare found</text>
    <text x="31" y="535" font-family="Poppins" font-size="22" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">$486</text>
    <text x="91" y="534" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">per traveler</text>
    <text x="31" y="562" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">Updated yesterday, 17:46</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="280" y="506" width="48" height="26" rx="13" fill="#3865E0"/>
      <circle cx="315" cy="519" r="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    </g>
    <text x="280" y="556" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#007AFF">View fares</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="280" y="563" width="61" height="20" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CCCCCC" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="292" y="577" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#777777">Delete</text>
      <line x1="329" y1="570" x2="335" y2="576" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="1.3"/>
      <line x1="335" y1="570" x2="329" y2="576" stroke="#777777" stroke-width="1.3"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Add alert prompt -->
  <g>
    <rect x="16" y="613" width="343" height="51" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CCCCCC" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="40" cy="638" r="13" fill="#E8EEFF"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="631" x2="40" y2="645" stroke="#007AFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="33" y1="638" x2="47" y2="638" stroke="#007AFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="64" y="644" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#007AFF">Create a new price alert</text>
    <polyline points="337,633 342,638 337,643" fill="none" stroke="#007AFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation shadow and surface -->
  <rect x="0" y="744" width="375" height="4" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
  <rect x="0" y="742" width="375" height="70" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <g>
    <!-- Search -->
    <circle cx="42" cy="766" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#CCCCCC" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="48" y1="772" x2="54" y2="778" stroke="#CCCCCC" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="28" y="798" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#CCCCCC">Search</text>
    <!-- Main -->
    <polygon points="116,762 105,771 108,771 108,780 124,780 124,771 127,771" fill="none" stroke="#CCCCCC" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <rect x="112" y="773" width="8" height="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CCCCCC" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="106" y="798" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#CCCCCC">Main</text>
    <!-- Notifications active -->
    <circle cx="197" cy="758" r="4" fill="#3865E0"/>
    <rect x="190" y="763" width="14" height="14" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#3865E0" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="188" y1="777" x2="206" y2="777" stroke="#3865E0" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="197" cy="781" r="2" fill="#3865E0"/>
    <text x="174" y="798" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#3865E0">Notification</text>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="305" cy="766" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#CCCCCC" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="305" cy="780" rx="12" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#CCCCCC" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="289" y="798" font-family="Open Sans" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#CCCCCC">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
